args.title: Fix issue 4424 in src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The function formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts generates the filename using at.toISOString().slice(0, 10) which returns the date in UTC, not local time. This causes evening exports in a local time zone behind UTC to have the next day's date in the filename. To fix, the function should use the local date in the time zone of the exporter instead of UTC date.

args.title: Fix issue 4429 in src/api/reports.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The issue is explained in the POST /reports/:id/duplicate endpoint handler, where a duplicated report's name is created by truncating the original report name with ' (copy)' added, but using a simple truncate to MAX_NAME_LENGTH can lead to the name ending with '...' instead of '(copy)' resulting in visually identical names. The fix is to change the logic to ensure '(copy)' always appears at the end by truncating with room for the suffix explicitly in src/api/reports.ts.

args.title: Fix issue 4434 in src/components/UploadForm.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

The UploadForm component stores upload error info in a 'problem' state, which is set when the upload fails. However, when a new file is selected (onChange handler of the file input), the 'problem' state is not cleared, so the old error message persists even after choosing a different file. The fix is to clear the 'problem' state to null when the file changes (e.g., inside the onChange handler that calls setFile).
